import sys
from collections import defaultdict

n = int(sys.stdin.readline())
degrees = []
sums = []

for _ in range(n):
    degree, s = map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())
    degrees.append(degree)
    sums.append(s)

edges = []
adjacent = defaultdict(list)

for i in range(n):
    for j in range(i + 1, n):
        if degrees[i] > 0 and degrees[j] > 0 and (sums[i] & (1 << j)) and (sums[j] & (1 << i)):
            edges.append((i, j))
            adjacent[i].append(j)
            adjacent[j].append(i)
            degrees[i] -= 1
            degrees[j] -= 1

print(len(edges))
for a, b in edges:
    print(a, b)
